description.text: Studying our Network and New Media program will provide you with a comprehensive grounding in the theories and ability, and you will gain in-depth knowledge of the key concepts associated with the new media in network society and grasp the recent developments and trends in traditional media, new media and information networks, enabling you engage confidently with all aspects of network and New Media and new media technologies. Learning outcomes To master the basic theory and knowledge of the humanities and social science To grasp the theory and knowledge of internet information, new media, and computer To have the application ability of information collection, collation, analysis, editing and management in the fields of Network and New Media Core Curriculum Introduction to Network and New Media, News interview and writing, Network and new media editor basis, the basis of Photography, Interactive Media Interface Design, Network advertising Planning and Design, Web page Planning and design, News Photography Technology, Network and New Media Video Program Editing， We-Media Creation and Operation, Network Operation and Management Future Career Some of the key career destinations include new media organizations, as well as press and broadcast organizations with a new media component, international news agencies, government departments, advertising firms, public relations organizations, and many others.

duration.text: The Network and Multi-media Applications at Liaoning Communication University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The following materials have to be prepared, photocopies or fax submissions are accepted, the original documents can be submitted after acceptance of admission. (1) Application form for Foreigners Wishing to Study in of Liaoning Communication University (2) The first page and one blank page of the passport (3) Physical Examination Record for Foreigners (4) Certificate of highest academic degree obtained and transcript of academic record (In English or in Chinese) (5) 2-inch color photos (6) Financial Proof or other warranty to ensure the students can cover all the expenses during their study in China (7) The above materials should be written in English or in Chinese, or attach a translation in either of the two languages. Relevant forms are available from Chinese Embassies, consulates or LNCU

requirements.text: All applicants must be in good health. (1) Undergraduate Programs 4 years ( in English Medium): Under the age of 30, a high school graduate or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. (2) Undergraduate Programs 4 years ( in Chinese Medium): HSK level 6 required (3) Non-degree Chinese Language Course: No prerequisite required.
